item.title: Eddie Gutierrez debunks death hoax: 'Buhay na buhay po ako'
item.description: Veteran actor Eddie Gutierrez has taken to social media to debunk rumors about his passing. On Facebook, his daughter Ruffa Gutierrez shared a video of the actor personally addressing the false reports. “Alam n'yo, usong-uso ang fake news ngayon, na ako'y sumakabilang buhay na," Eddie said. "Hindi po totoo 'yon. Buhay na buhay po ako. I'm still alive and kicking. Hindi pa ako namamatay. Binigyan pa ako ng Panginoon ng mga ilang taon."
